page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the ARM64 architecture, powered by Alibaba's custom YiTian710 processor. The instance provides 4 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz without simultaneous multithreading, providing 4 vCPUs alongside 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. The CPU topology features 64 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 64 MB L3 cache, with hardware acceleration for AES cryptographic operations. Operating under the KVM hypervisor, this configuration does not include local disk storage or hardware accelerators, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results characterize the instance as a balanced middle-tier performer for typical compute and memory workloads. The system achieves a multi-core stress-ng score of 7230.46 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4604.0, demonstrating consistent multi-threaded CPU output. Clang software compilation posts 6181.0 points, while Redis SET throughput reaches 6.71 million operations per second and static web serving delivers 6.51 GB/sec. Memory read bandwidth measures 63.39 GB/sec on large uncached blocks, though uncached write bandwidth falls into the lower tier at 25.44 GB/sec. Hardware limitations are evident in vector-heavy and specialized tasks: lack of x86 vector extensions and modest single-core throughput yield low scores in Geekbench ray tracing, PassMark encryption, and LLM text generation.

From an operational and cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8y.xlarge provides predictable per-core performance due to its fully dedicated physical cores. Because it relies exclusively on remote block storage and lacks hardware accelerators, it offers an economical compute footprint for standard microservices, web hosting, Redis caching layers, and lightweight database workloads that do not demand extensive mathematical vector extensions or local high-IOPS NVMe drives.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.xlarge is a general-purpose ARM64 virtual server powered by a 4-core Alibaba YiTian710 processor operating at 2.75 GHz with 16.0 GB of RAM. Featuring dedicated single-threaded physical cores, 64 MB of L3 cache, and a 3 Gbps network baseline, this instance balances processing capacity and memory density without bundled local storage or GPUs. Performance testing reflects steady mid-range throughput, with 7230.46 in multi-core stress-ng tests, 6.71 million Redis SET operations per second, and 6.51 GB/sec in static web serving. While uncached memory write speeds and vector-intensive cryptographic routines benchmark in the lower tiers, the dedicated core architecture provides consistent compute efficiency. The instance is suited for containerized web applications, API services, distributed caching, and general cloud workloads.
